All core new features (Executive live toggle, Coaching Hub live toggle, file-upload panel, audio recorder panel, landing PNG logo, sticky nav, scroll reveals, FAQ, 8 new sections) WORK correctly end-to-end.

critical.issue: 502 error detail leaks 'OpenAIException' / 'openai' / 'litellm' upstream names. Spec says detail must start with 'RetOps transcription failed' and NOT leak vendor names. Currently: "RetOps transcription failed: Failed to transcribe audio: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - ...". Need to strip or replace upstream exception text before raising HTTPException(502).

Binary (non-text) file with null bytes is accepted (returns 200) and scored on garbled text. Spec says 422 on binary non-text. Need to validate decoded transcript (e.g., reject if >5% null/control chars or if UTF-8 decode yields many replacement chars) before scoring.

ui_bugs.issue: Toggle buttons use data-testid 'coaching-mode-demo' / 'coaching-mode-live' but spec calls for 'mode-demo' / 'mode-live' inside the coaching-mode-toggle wrapper (matching Executive View pattern). Rename to 'mode-demo' / 'mode-live' for consistency.

action_items: Fix upload-audio 502 detail — sanitize the upstream exception before raising; final detail should be something like 'RetOps transcription failed: unsupported audio format' without 'openai', 'litellm', or 'emergent' substrings.
Fix upload-file binary rejection — add a text-content sanity check (decode + ratio of printable chars) and return 422 with detail 'File is not a readable text transcript' for binary payloads.
Rename CoachingHub toggle data-testids from 'coaching-mode-demo/live' to 'mode-demo/live' so both pages share a consistent testid convention (optional, cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: upload-audio error path (server.py ~line 1239) should wrap the transcription call in try/except and re-raise HTTPException(502, detail='RetOps transcription failed') WITHOUT appending str(exc). Current implementation leaks the full upstream stack trace message.

upload-file text validation (server.py ~line 1178) relies solely on UTF-8 decode success, which silently succeeds on any byte sequence when errors='replace'/'ignore'. Add a heuristic guard (null-byte count, replacement-char ratio) to reject opaque binaries.
Executive View DataModeToggle and Coaching Hub toggle duplicate the same small component — consider extracting to shared components/DataModeToggle.jsx to keep testids + styling in sync.

Several static values on Executive View tiles (top_reasons/segments lists) are hardcoded arrays in JSX even in live mode — if user expects these to swap with live data, wire them to liveChurn.top_reasons / liveChurn.segments too. Currently only the 4 stat tiles and Strategic Insights swap.

rca of the issue: Issue 1 (vendor leak): server.py upload-audio catches the transcription exception and does `raise HTTPException(502, detail=f'RetOps transcription failed: {exc}')` — the f-string interpolates the full litellm/OpenAI error message. Fix: ignore the exception string and raise a generic detail, or map known error categories (quota, format, timeout) to user-facing messages. Issue 2 (binary accepted): the upload-file handler likely does `content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')` which always succeeds; the resulting '\x00B\x00B...' string bypasses validation. Fix: after decode, compute ratio of printable characters; if <0.8 raise 422 with detail 'File is not a readable text transcript'.
